description: This file contains static helper functions for file input/output operations related to PDF documents, including saving, showing, and converting documents, primarily for the PDFsharp library. It also includes commented-out code for drawing visuals and rendering images, which are not active.

classes.name: IOHelper
classes.description: A static class providing helper functions for file input/output operations involving PDF documents, including saving, showing, and converting PDFs.

methods.name: SaveToStreamOrSaveToFileAsync
methods.description: Saves a PDF document to a stream or file, optionally showing it.

methods.name: SaveAndShowDocumentAsync
methods.description: Saves a PDF document and opens it in a viewer.
